QuestInfo.name: Romero's Secret
QuestInfo.1: #p3001004# asked you to take care of #p3001005# stock and gave you the #b#t4033367##k. Find #b#p3001006##k and let him know you want to buy.

0.0: Hey guardian! I heard you've been loafing about with #p3001006#. Things went well, yes?
0.1: I'm sure you can see where #p3001005# overdid it. If he doesn't reach his quotas, he can't properly be considered a leader of our guild, can he?
0.2: The burden of a bad trade is something the merchant should shoulder himself. That is why I will not offer my assistance. Not directly at least. I purchased a good stock of #b#t4000727##k and #b#t4033413##k. Their value should be rising as we speak.
0.3: Obviously, I can't trade them myself, can I? That's why I want you to participate in my stead. This will make me a hefty profit... if it helps #p3001005# in the process, that is not my concern...

yes.0: Take this #b#t4033367##k. This is for other merchants only. Tell him you will purchase everything he has at a price which will not be a loss for him.
yes.1: Go make a trade with #b#p3001006##k and return forthwith!

yes.0: We've done a good thing today. And that good thing was procuring large amounts of currency.
yes.1: Enjoy those mesos! But spend them wisely.
yes.2: Now, forget about #p3001005#. There is important work to be done.
